# Global Public Surface — Phase One Breadth

The Awtsmoos reveals many worlds without letting discovery become clutter;
Awtsmoos.com should expose every real app and game through one clean public constellation, while advanced power folds behind calm doors instead of spilling into the gutter.

## Mission

1. Enumerate every real public app and game entry from filesystem evidence.
2. Compare that universe against `/apps` and `/games` catalog links/cards.
3. Exclude explicit tests, debug pages, old/archive copies, temporary folders, generated internals, and private implementation-only subroutes unless the surrounding project clearly treats them as public products.
4. Expose every missing product through the correct catalog rather than leaving discoverability to guessed URLs.
5. Keep catalog cards simple: name, concise purpose, clean action. Advanced metadata may fold or stay in internal manifests rather than cluttering the visible grid.
6. Preserve existing working catalog design unless runtime proves a mobile defect.
7. Rank remaining UI risk by fixed overlays, hard widths/min-widths, menus/dialogs, viewport units, extreme stacking, hover-without-active, and incomplete responsive states.
8. Runtime-probe high-risk clean surfaces at 390×844 and 320×568 before production changes.
9. Prefer small late polish modules over edits to legacy >120-line files.
10. Apply `?compact=true` at browser module entry boundaries only after targeted CompactJS compilation passes.

## Public catalog acceptance

- Every eligible app/game entry has at least one visible link from `/apps` or `/games`.
- No duplicate cards for the same canonical route.
- No dead/test/debug/temporary route appears as a public product.
- Catalog remains mobile-contained with no horizontal spill.
- Cards/actions have hover, active, and focus-visible behavior when they animate.
- Advanced/secondary details do not dominate the initial scan.
